name: Fujiwara Mei
source:
Star Sign: Virgo

A high school student from the real world that was summoned to the magical one by accident. She doesn't know a way back so she started living there.
A curious girl who loves new things.
She's brimming with vitality and thinks it's fun to be in a new world.
